basic_info.description: Golden opportunity in the Oceanview district of San Francisco! The ideal choice for anyone seeking a move in ready home. Thoughtfully updated for the perfect blend of practicality and contemporary. New flooring, fresh paint, and updated touches throughout. The spacious home features 4 beds 2 baths boasting at 1555sqft. Large windows and open concept living and dining areas are flooded with natural light, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere into the brand-new kitchen with new stainless-steel appliances, sleek countertops, and ample cabinetry for abundant storage. Each bedroom and bath providing comfortable space perfect for larger families. Step outside to enjoy the private outdoor space and backyard ideal for hosting gatherings. Provides easy access to public transportation, parks, schools like SFSU, CCSF, shopping and dining at Stonestown Galleria, H Mart Supermarket, and a variety of choices all within close proximity. Enjoy all of San Francisco's classic charm here at 250 Ramsell St.
